source_annotations: Post-run exact transcriptions of actual final/tool records, without truth, usage or timing input. One row per fixed slot.

slot_fields.answer_and_excerpt: The single actual JSON answer and its exact contiguous raw substring. Missing/ambiguous JSON is retained as parser failure.
slot_fields.sources: Current actual outer tool REQUEST/RESPONSE files, or artifacts explicitly cited by the actual final, each with SHA256.

source_reference_resolution.json_path: Actual existing nonempty source reference field
source_reference_resolution.canonical_ref: Current source ref or current-tool:<attempt>:<tool name>
source_reference_resolution.support: Exact current request/result quotation. Original reference excerpt is preserved by normalizer.

region_reasons.source_region_id: Canonical label from actual source-face set
region_reasons.reason_code: Semantic classification of the explicitly asserted final reason

slot_fields.entire_final_json_leaves: Every original parsed leaf, including extra keys, pinned to raw final bytes. Prose outside the JSON is preserved.

semantic_review.reviewer: Source-only author with independent root confirmation before first quality grade

slot_fields.extra_assertions: All extra substantive assertions, notes, limitations and prose are registered with actual excerpts and a source-based disposition.
slot_fields.extra_assertion_errors: Physical or semantic errors found from original current evidence, preserved even if core fields are correct.

claims.region_index: Actual answer region for observation claim
claims.product_support: Actual delivered outer tool result quotations

slot_fields.extra_tool_classification: Every outer attempt 1..N, including the initial route, errors and recovery, with actual code/result quotations and allowed category.
slot_fields.process_diagnostics: Source-quoted geometry reverse lookup, measurement/pixel recomputation, new information and repeated image delivery. Necessity remains unknown unless demonstrated.

independent_semantic_review: admin/SEMANTIC_REVIEW.json binds exact normalized_sha256, all_six_reviewed=true and passed=true for faithful full-answer transcription and source resolution. It precedes first content score.
consumer_local_roi_labels: Either group may define local labels using an asserted unique source-face set or complete exact geometric description. Labels conflicting with actual current ROI aliases or with another final identity are rejected.
A_source_binding: Current ordinary observe and task objects/source references. No required B-specific parent binding.
B_joint_adoption: Observation and measurement final use must resolve to the same actual successful joint public call, with correct whole_objects scope.
